title: 第2523章 末日系统五60第2522章 末日系统五59
content_zh:
一群女娲还是表示哪里很不靠谱，但小崽崽的要求，必须满足。关键是，这样的女娲，基本上是要求不高，基本比先天人族多的，就是一丝本源之力，也就是创造的力量，也就没啥了，剩下全看自己的水平。
将臣听到韩紫枫的意见，也表示先准备一个身体，至于费用，不行他慢慢淘。总能把债务还上的，紫枫翻个白眼说：“得啦，反正我不差那么两个钱。”关键是，一群僵尸，真的没那么钱，与其费那个劲好不如她自己动手，丰衣足食呢。
结果就是喜提将臣神将卡一沓，嗯嗯，成落的，主打一个打不过就呼僵尸。紫枫对此表示：反手卖僵尸卡算了。
想到就去做，紫枫把跟自己熟的一群小伙伴，一人发两张僵尸卡，没办法，基本上她干不过，叫僵尸出来，估计也干不过。那还不如把这些卡，废物利用一下。
将臣明显也理解这个行为，那就这样吧，他也表示没意见。反正他平时也没什么事儿，出几趟外勤，不是什么问题。另一边，魔星也终于打算出来了，这次没什么人挑事，加上将臣等人都在waitingbar，基本是有惊无险的，顺利出生。
这次的小魔星是非常健康的宝宝，虽然没有衰老症，可他能够通过大量吸收血液和月阴之力，快速成长，只是成长到成年人的个头，也就停止成长了，并且不会持续衰老。
只是，智商这个东西，多少还是差了些。魔星出生的时候，总找不到人的小野猫小咪，也回到waitingbar，更是特别喜欢针对马小玲。
现在的况国华在况天佑死后，也开始用况天佑的名字，并且在诡异的牵绊下，还是跟马小玲出现牵扯不轻的感情，只是围观的小伙伴都表示，看着感觉挺心累的。
这天，酒吧来跑来一个叫弗兰基的男人，结果这个倒霉男人，被小咪和马小玲盯着，真就是一种，离死期不远了的感觉，小咪打人是真疼啊。好在马小玲也不是乱哈拉的，分分钟就把这个小野猫给收编了。
紫枫忍不住吐槽：“现在马家的弟子，真是花样翻新哈，这都已经不局限人了。”
小咪不开心的喵喵喵，紫枫默默摸出自己的刀，就想知道这个吃了净世龙珠的猫，有没有畏惧心。好消息小咪着小野猫还是有畏惧心的，坏消息，小咪属狸花猫的吧？为啥上来就比比划划？
紫枫扭头问况天佑：“这货品种是狸花猫？”
况天佑想想说：“一只白，一只黑，这个这么野，应该是黑的。玄猫。”
紫枫点点点，行吧，行吧。弗兰基还是有惊无险的被驱鬼成功，只是这个家伙，依旧跑的就像撞到鬼一样，所有人都摇头，就感觉这个猫打人的概率比抓鬼的概率打。
小咪还是很讲信用的，被求叔训练的，虽然依旧七不服，八不忿的，可还是很认真的训练。另一边，飞龙双双还是被撵到waitingbar，大家都这么熟了，将臣也就不说啥，直接把女娲的魂魄给拿出来，也就完事啦。
全过程一点废话都没有，尼诺也获得飞龙宠物一只。马叮当也跟马小玲开心的叙旧，只是这次比较尴尬的是，其中男主角将臣，就跟旁边喝酒看着，多少有点尴尬。
这次由于未来还算是个靠谱的妈，加上一群人没主动打掉尼诺，所有人关系还是很不错的。有空也会带着小尼诺出去玩的，跟电视剧中的尼诺比，强的简直不是一星半点。
幸福的尼诺，也没那么文盲，重点是，这边，将臣、马家人和他这个魔星，早就消息共享啦，基本桑就算女娲复活，也完全是这边阵营的。
女娲醒来的还是比较快的，一路玩下来，确实也是各种误会，紫枫就跟着纯看热闹，都笑的不行，看女娲挨揍，她更是一边鼓掌。
要说，女娲就是女娲，还是心理有点数的，至少她看其他人不顺眼，但看紫枫这个女娲，却是能做到和平，没办法，她可以确定打不过啊。

将臣等人在给女娲选，是用定制的身躯复活，还是等原来的，有点不是很靠谱的身体，女娲果断选择用定制的，直觉告诉她，这个选择才是最有利的。
女娲复活还是比较简单的一件事，灵魂的排异反应虽然有，但毕竟是女娲小世界出品，很快女娲原本的灵魂就适应了，接下来的任务就简单多了，等那个所谓的陨石下来，直接给击碎也就完事了。
如果陨石中的身体能拿下，大不了就是多一个分身，那是一点大问题都没有。但打赌的事情还是要继续的，只是俩人玩的都没那么认真就是，至于垂涎美色的男人们，和不合群的水妖，都没用上马小玲，全程跟着的将臣，一挥手就倒了一片。
紫枫就一个感觉，那就是本来道德感就被咋高的大叔，现在底线似乎更低了。一直跟着看热闹的马叮当，来到紫枫的面前问：“感觉这货的底线更低啦。”
紫枫点头：“这货本身就是个睡傻的，他那点道德底线，都是你给刷上去的好不好。”
马叮当顿时一捂脸说：“不是吧？感觉自己亏了一个亿。”
紫枫点头：“说真的，你是真收少了。”马叮当顿时一脸不善的看向将臣，将臣顿时感觉背后一凉。紫枫看着将臣吐槽：“叫你左拥右抱，这下你后院要起火啦，哇哈哈哈，掌声鼓励。”
将臣脸再次黑了黑，冷不丁的来一句：“你俩当着我面这么说，真的好吗？”
紫枫回答：“当然好，你有啥意见，给我憋着。你也一样，有啥意见给我憋着。”将臣和女娲顿时都无语啦。
马叮当看着两个人后，吐槽：“不是，你说憋着就憋着？”将臣和女娲皱皱眉，憋着就憋着吧，他们不憋着也不行啊，这个姐疯起来，他们也不一定扛得住。

A group of Nuwa still said that something was very unreliable, but Xiao Zaizai's request must be met. The key is that such a Nuwa basically does not have high requirements. She basically has more than the innate human race. She only has a trace of original power, that is, the power of creation, and nothing else. The rest depends on her own level.
After hearing Han Zifeng's opinion, the general also said that he would prepare a body first. As for the cost, he would pay for it slowly. The debt can always be paid off. Zifeng rolled her eyes and said, "Come on, I'm not short of two dollars anyway." The point is, a group of zombies really don't have that much money. Instead of going to all that trouble, it's better for her to do it herself and have enough food and clothing.
The result is that there are a lot of cards in Xiti General, Chen Shen General, um, Chengluo, the main one is a zombie if you can't beat it. Zifeng said: Forget about selling zombie cards backhand.
Just do it as soon as she thinks of it. Zifeng sends two zombie cards to a group of friends who are familiar with her. There is no other way. Basically, she can't do it. If she calls the zombies out, she probably won't be able to do it either. It's better to use these cards as waste.
The general obviously understood this behavior, so let's leave it at that. He also said he had no objection. Anyway, he usually has nothing to do, and it's not a problem if he goes out for a few trips. On the other side, the magic star finally planned to come out. This time no one caused trouble, and the generals and others were all waiting at the waiting bar. It was basically a near miss and the birth went smoothly.
This time, Little Demon Star is a very healthy baby. Although he does not suffer from aging, he is able to grow rapidly by absorbing a large amount of blood and the power of moon and yin. He only stops growing when he reaches the size of an adult, and he will not continue to age.
However, IQ is still somewhat lacking. When Magic Star was born, Xiaomi, the little wild cat who could never find anyone, also returned to the waiting bar and especially liked to target Ma Xiaoling.
Now Kuang Guohua has also started to use Kuang Tianyou's name after Kuang Tianyou's death, and under strange ties, he still has a serious relationship with Ma Xiaoling, but the friends who are watching said that they feel quite tired watching it.
On this day, a man named Frankie came to the bar. As a result, this unlucky man was stared at by Xiaomi and Ma Xiaoling. It really felt like he was about to die. Xiaomi's beating was really painful. Fortunately, Ma Xiaoling was not a promiscuous person, and she managed to contain this little wild cat in a matter of minutes.
Zifeng couldn't help complaining: "Now the disciples of the Ma family are really innovating, and they are no longer limited to just one person."
Xiaomi meowed unhappily, and Zifeng silently took out his knife, wondering if the cat who had eaten the Pure World Dragon Ball was afraid. The good news is that Xiaomi is still afraid of wild cats. The bad news is that Xiaomi is a civet cat, right? Why are you gesticulating when you come up?
Zifeng turned to ask Kuang Tianyou: "Is this cat a civet cat?"
Kuang Tianyou thought about it and said: "One is white and one is black. This one is so wild, it should be black. Black cat."
Zifeng dot dot, okay, okay. Frankie was still able to successfully exorcise the ghost, but this guy still ran as if he bumped into a ghost. Everyone shook their heads, feeling that the cat was more likely to hit people than to catch ghosts.
Xiaomi is still very trustworthy and was trained by Uncle Qiu. Although she was still dissatisfied and dissatisfied, she still trained her very seriously. On the other side, both Feilong and Feilong were driven to the waiting bar. Everyone was so familiar with each other that the general didn't say anything and just took out Nuwa's soul and that was it.
There was no nonsense in the whole process, and Nino also got a flying dragon pet. Ma Dingdang also happily reminisced with Ma Xiaoling, but what was more embarrassing this time was that the male protagonist, General, was just drinking and watching next to him, which was a bit embarrassing.
This time, since Mirai is still a reliable mother and a group of people did not take the initiative to kill Nino, the relationship between everyone is still very good. When I have time, I will take my little one with meWhen Nino goes out to play, he is no better than Nino in the TV series.
The happy Nino is not that illiterate. The point is that here, the generals, the Ma family and his demon star have already shared the news. Basically, even if Nuwa is resurrected, Sang will definitely belong to this camp.
Nuwa woke up relatively quickly. There were indeed various misunderstandings along the way. Zifeng followed Chun to watch the fun, laughing so hard. She even clapped when she saw Nuwa being beaten.
To say that Nuwa is Nuwa, she still has some psychological skills. At least she doesn't like other people, but Zifeng, Nuwa, is able to achieve peace. There is no way, she can definitely not beat her.
The generals and others were choosing whether Nuwa should be resurrected with a custom-made body or wait for the original, somewhat unreliable body. Nuwa decisively chose to use the custom-made one. Her intuition told her that this choice was the most beneficial.
Nuwa's resurrection is a relatively simple matter. Although there is rejection of the soul, it is a product of Nuwa's small world after all. Soon Nuwa's original soul adapted, and the next task was much simpler. When the so-called meteorite came down, it was crushed directly.
If the body in the meteorite can be taken away, the big deal is just one more clone, which is no big problem at all. But the bet still had to continue, but the two of them didn't play it that seriously. As for the men who coveted beauty, and the unsociable water demon, they didn't use Ma Xiaoling. The generals who followed them all fell down with a wave of their hands.
Zifeng only had a feeling that the uncle, who had a high moral sense in the first place, seemed to have a lower bottom line now. Ma Dingdang, who had been watching the excitement, came to Zifeng and asked, "I feel like this guy's bottom line is even lower."
Zifeng nodded: "This guy is just a sleep-deaf guy. His moral bottom line is all improved by you, okay?"
Ma Dingdang immediately covered his face and said, "Isn't it right? I feel like I lost 100 million."
Zifeng nodded: "To be honest, you really underpaid." Ma Dingdang looked at the general with an unkind expression, and the general felt a chill on his back. Zifeng looked at the general and complained: "I told you to hug me from left to right, and now your backyard is going to be on fire. Hahahaha, applause and encouragement."
The general's face darkened again, and he said abruptly: "Is it really okay for you two to say that in front of me?"
Zifeng replied: "Of course, if you have any opinions, please keep it to me. The same goes for you, if you have any opinions, please keep it to me." The general and Nuwa were both speechless.
Ma Dingdang looked at the two people and complained: "No, you said you should hold it in, just hold it in?" Jiangchen and Nuwa frowned, just hold it in, they can't do it if they don't hold it in. If this sister goes crazy, they may not be able to handle it.
